title: Exercise Git warning and post-exit drain policy through runner entry points
outcome: Behavioral coverage detects a Git runner losing its extended drain bound or warning, submodule runners losing shared warning ownership, or Engram/default callers accidentally opting into Git drain policy.
acceptance: Tests drive production runner or entry-point wiring and fail if Git warning/drain arguments are dropped or a child runner gets an independent warning owner.
Coverage checks Git extended drain and Engram/default shared one-second grace through observable behavior using controlled IO/time, without source-text pins, real long sleeps or timing thresholds.
Relevant focused tests pass and the review provenance and deferred scope are recorded.
